description: Tool to update an existing issue in a GitLab project (title, description, labels, assignees, state, etc.). Use when you need to modify issue details, close/reopen issues, or manage labels and assignments.

add_labels.description: Comma-separated label names to add to the issue without affecting existing labels.
add_labels.title: Add Labels

assignee_ids.description: The IDs of the users to assign the issue to. Set to [0] or provide empty array to unassign all.
assignee_ids.title: Assignee Ids

confidential.description: Set an issue to be confidential.
confidential.title: Confidential

description.description: The description of the issue. Limited to 1,048,576 characters.
description.title: Description

discussion_locked.description: Flag indicating if the issue's discussion is locked. If the discussion is locked, only project members can add or edit comments.
discussion_locked.title: Discussion Locked

due_date.description: The due date. Date time string in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
due_date.title: Due Date

epic_id.description: ID of the epic to add the issue to. Valid values are greater than or equal to 0. Premium and Ultimate only.
epic_id.title: Epic Id

id.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.
issue_iid.title: Issue Iid

issue_type.description: The type of issue. One of 'issue', 'incident', 'test_case', or 'task'.
issue_type.title: Issue Type

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to replace the entire label set. Set to empty string to remove all labels.
labels.title: Labels

milestone_id.description: The global ID of a milestone to assign to the issue. Set to 0 to unassign milestone.
milestone_id.title: Milestone Id

remove_labels.description: Comma-separated label names to remove from the issue.
remove_labels.title: Remove Labels

state_event.description: State event to perform on the issue. Use 'close' to close the issue or 'reopen' to reopen it.
state_event.title: State Event

updated_at.description: When the issue was updated. Date time string, ISO 8601 formatted. Requires administrator or project/group owner rights.
updated_at.title: Updated At

weight.description: The weight of the issue. Valid values are greater than or equal to 0. Premium and Ultimate only.
weight.title: Weight

name: update_project_issue

closed_at.description: Timestamp of when the issue was closed.
closed_at.title: Closed At

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the issue was created.
created_at.title: Created At

discussion_locked.description: Indicates if discussion on the issue is locked.
discussion_locked.title: Discussion Locked

iid.description: The internal ID of the issue.
iid.title: Iid

labels.description: List of labels assigned to the issue.
labels.title: Labels

merge_requests_count.description: Number of merge requests related to the issue.
merge_requests_count.title: Merge Requests Count

project_id.description: The ID of the project the issue belongs to.
project_id.title: Project Id

state.description: The state of the issue (e.g., opened, closed).
state.title: State

subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the issue.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

time_stats.description: Time tracking statistics for the issue.
time_stats.title: Time Stats

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the issue was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user_notes_count.description: Number of user notes on the issue.
user_notes_count.title: User Notes Count
